item.title: What Edu is reading this week (Aug 2 - Sep 5, 2026)
item.description: Back from holidays, so this one covers everything that piled up over the last month: new model releases, Slurm on Kubernetes, a lot of BSD, the Omarchy funding argument, ADS-B receivers and a stack of retro and homelab projects. AI, Models & Agents Introducing Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1: Anthropic’s latest models for coding and knowledge work, with an early look at how they contribute to scientific research. Introducing Gemini 3.
